name: AffiliateWP
couldBuild: Referral links with a tracking cookie, an affiliate registration form, commission records written on each order, and a dashboard showing what is owed.
stillMissing: Paying people is where it stops being a plugin. Bulk payouts to real bank accounts, tax forms, fraud and self-referral detection, and cross-device attribution that survives ad blockers. Add integrations with whichever ecommerce plugin you use, each with its own refund semantics that have to claw commissions back.
requirements: Referral tracking that survives across devices and common blockers
Affiliate registration, approval and a self-service dashboard
Commission rules per product, per affiliate and per tier
Payouts, including reversal when an order is refunded
Integration with your store plugin's order lifecycle

alternatives.name: SliceWP
alternatives.desc: A free affiliate plugin covering tracking and commissions for simpler programmes.

alternatives.name: Rewardful / PartnerStack
alternatives.desc: Hosted affiliate platforms that own payouts and compliance for you.

notes: No free tier — the purest premium entry in the plugin index.
